name: 2N3904
description: NPN 汎用トランジスタ (TO-92, ピン1=E 2=B 3=C)。データシート (onsemi) の表と代表特性から作った等価モデル
hfe_note: データシートに hFE の typ が無いので、山の高さは表の min 100 と max 300 (10 mA) の幾何平均 173 に置きました。実物の hFE は、同じ型番でも 100〜300 と大きく違います。
remarks: hfe_norm: Figure 15. The data sheet has no typical hFE: the curve's peak is placed at 173, the geometric mean of the table's min 100 and max 300 at 10 mA (the table's min at 0.1 / 1 / 50 / 100 mA stay below it)

vbe_on, vbe_sat, vce_sat: Figure 17. Its printed axis labels sit off the grid lines; the grid lines are a plain log axis from 1 to 200 mA and were used. Below 5 mA the drawn VBE curve is flatter than any junction can be, so it is not used.
cibo, cobo: Figure 3 (Cibo emitter-base with the collector open, Cobo collector-base with the emitter open)
ft_min: no typ is given, so the model is as slow as the min allows (TF = 1 / (2 pi fT)); hoe: min and max at IC = 1 mA, VCE = 10 V (VAF from the geometric mean)
